items.title: AWS named a Leader in IDC MarketScape for public cloud object storage
items.summary: AWS has been named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for North America Public Cloud Object Storage 2026-2027 Vendor Assessment (November 2026). IDC found that object storage is no longer just a place to keep data. Analytics engines, AI pipelines, and agents now read straight from the bucket, so the storage layer affects how those […]
